what: The release's Shipping settings hold shipping zones, each a group of the places the store ships to with its own shipping methods: woocommerce-11.2.1:includes/admin/settings/views/html-admin-page-shipping-zones.php line 22 (kind: shipped) says "A shipping zone consists of the region(s) you'd like to ship to and the shipping method(s) offered. A shopper can only be matched to one zone, and we'll use their shipping address to show them the methods available in their area.", line 87 "A shipping zone is a geographic region where a certain set of shipping methods and rates apply.", and line 57, of the zone for places not listed, "An optional zone you can use to set the shipping method(s) available to any regions that have not been listed above." So a part of the store that groups some of its places and holds its own settings (shipping methods and rates) for them is in what is held; line 11's "no part of a store holding its own settings for some of its places" says more than the reading supports. What the zones hold is shipping only: no search found a part holding prices, currencies or content for a group of places (WooPayments' multi-currency setup page switches a customer to "their local currency" by geolocation, per currency, not per group of places). Q1:73 speaks of prices, currencies and content per place and is not touched.
fix: Record: what_is_missing to "a part of one store that groups some of the places it sells to and holds its own prices, currencies or content for them, with the rest taken from the store (shipping zones hold only 'the shipping method(s) offered' to their 'region(s)')", with read adding woocommerce-11.2.1:includes/admin/settings/views/html-admin-page-shipping-zones.php. Q1:11 to: "WooCommerce's reading showed no part of a store holding its own prices, currencies or content for some of its places: its shipping zones hold only 'the region(s) you'd like to ship to and the shipping method(s) offered', and its 'Selling location(s)' is one setting for the store."

what: Not found: no held document shows a plan or subscription level of the platform deciding which payment methods a store can turn on. The row's read files hold no plan (the PCI DSS page names only "your hosting provider"; PaymentUtils.php and class-wc-settings-advanced.php hold no plan, subscription or fee). The searches find plans only outside payment methods: the release's woocommerce-11.2.1:src/Admin/RemoteSpecs/RuleProcessors/IsWooExpressRuleProcessor.php is a "Rule processor that passes (or fails) when the site is on a Woo Express plan.", used only as the rule type 'is_woo_express' of GetRuleProcessor.php (remote specs), with nothing held tying it to which methods a store can turn on; and woocommerce.com/products/ shows "Paid plans start at 0/month" for an extension. Q5:11 and Q5:163 hold. Q5:133 says "a plan level was not in what was read on WooCommerce", wider than the row: a Woo Express plan is in what was read; what was not is a plan level that decides which methods a store can use.
